2. RUN git fetch origin main
   IF it fails because there is no `origin`: RUN git merge-base main HEAD
   IF it fails for any other reason: continue with the `origin/main` I already have.
3. RUN git merge-base origin/main HEAD
   IF the fetch in step 2 failed because there is no `origin`: skip this, since step 2 already gave BASE.
4. RUN git rev-parse HEAD
5. RUN git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AR <BASE>..HEAD -- ':/specs/plans/completed/'
   IF it prints nothing (expected, since no file under specs/ changed): go to step 6.
   IF it prints a path: it is a plan branch. Ask no question, and dispatch the explainer subagent with `Plan branch: yes`.
